errors.evidence: The figure contains two separate diagrams (charts), not a single one.
The vertical axis on both charts is scaled from -0.5 to 3.5, not starting from 0.

errors.text_span: Es gibt zwei Sätze von gestapelten Balken, wobei jeder Satz einen bestimmten Zeitraum repräsentiert.
errors.evidence: The figure does not show two sets of bars for different time periods. It shows two complete, separate charts that both cover the same time period (1991-2023) but display different data (gross vs. net investments).

errors.text_span: Der erste Satz, der die Jahre 1991 bis 2015 umfasst
errors.evidence: The first chart is not limited to the years 1991-2015; it covers the full range from 1991 to 2023. The 2015 endpoint is fabricated.

errors.text_span: wobei die höchste Gesamthöhe um 1996 liegt
errors.evidence: The highest total height of the bars in the left chart occurs in the first years (1991-1992) at over 3.0%. The value in 1996 is visibly lower, at approximately 2.6%.

errors.text_span: Der zweite Satz, der die Jahre 2000 bis 2023 umfasst, besteht aus einem schwarzen Linienplot, der „Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt“ darstellt.
errors.evidence: This description is a complete fabrication. The second chart on the right is also a stacked bar chart with a line plot, and it covers the entire 1991-2023 period. It is not just a line plot from 2000 onwards.

The description completely fails to explain why there are two charts and what the fundamental difference between them is (i.e., the left chart shows gross investments and the right chart shows net investments, resulting in vastly different value ranges).

The description fails to mention the black line plot representing "Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt" on the first (left) chart. It only mentions the line in the context of its hallucinated 'second set'.
